- 10:30 PT — auth/telemetry verification and log handoff — Redwood infra (Karthik) + Clearwave (Nora)

Thanks Jonas — a couple of validation details to lock down (I’ll be on the call for Day-0):

Validation checklist highlights (short):
- SSH access: 2-of-3 MFA for bastion console logins, and session recording enabled
- Jump host NAT: ephemeral egress IPs for the first 72 hours (we’ll reserve an allowlist)
- KV/cache warmup: we will pre-seed the common prompt set (Laura will share list)
- Telemetry: ensure logs are forwarded to your SIEM endpoint over TLS and we have sampling set to 100% for the first 2 hours

Escalation path:
- 1st line: Ben Carter (Redwood infra) — for immediate connectivity fixes
- 2nd line: Karthik Iyer (Network & Ops) — for routing/NAT/firewall rules
- SLA exceptions: Jonas Weber to coordinate with Clearwave management

Please attach the bastion public keys (bastion-ssh-keys.csv) here when ready. We will provision the user accounts and return a confirmation email with session endpoint + connection string.

Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference
